articles.title: Djokovic makes a Beijing comeback as Sabalenka discusses self-pressure
articles.summary: Djokovic recovered to beat Bu Yunchaokete in three sets and keep his unbeaten Beijing record. Sabalenka opened with a victory and discussed the pressure she puts on herself.

articles.title: Alcaraz wins in three sets as Kartal marks her WTA return
articles.summary: Carlos Alcaraz beat Alex Michelsen at the Japan Open despite uneven serving. Sonay Kartal won in Beijing on her return to the WTA Tour after almost six months out with injury.

articles.title: Pikachu's orbital adventure brings space science to Pokémon fans
articles.summary: ESA revealed that a Pikachu plush completed about 1,040 trips around Earth during a 67-day space-station visit. A touring exhibition and museum game activities will connect Pokémon fans with space science.
